question: Primarily, an ant’s sting has which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Formic Acid.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Methanoic acid is found in ant stings. **

 
 
• **It is also called Formic acid (HCOOH).**
 
• It is commonly used in processing textiles and leather.
